scope: Sanitized Picard product work known from the live audit and existing project backlog. Not a complete export of the private owner board.

statusGuide.implemented_pending_deployment: Source and targeted regression checks exist; installation/live verification not yet asserted.
statusGuide.verified_on_deployment: Fix installed and exact behavior checked on the recorded host release; owner acceptance is separate.
statusGuide.planned: Requested or documented unfinished work; no implementation/delivery claim.
statusGuide.paused: Existing work deliberately paused; no new authority inferred.
statusGuide.fixture_only: Available only as an offline test/design fixture; production enablement is not claimed.
statusGuide.needs_design: Scope or authority contract needs design before implementation.

verification.scopeLimit: Two visible completed jobs; synthetic tests cover additional states. Not an exhaustive defect inventory.

items.title: Browser Back restores a selected job hidden by a retained filter
items.behavior: When history restores a loaded selected job that the filter excludes, Show resets to All loaded jobs and displays its details. Explicit filter changes still clear selection normally.
items.remaining: No further implementation for this scoped finding; owner acceptance remains separate.

items.title: Fresh observations briefly say age unknown
items.behavior: Health and updater age display zero seconds for tolerated future skew up to five seconds; stale, invalid and material future-time states remain distinct.
items.remaining: No further implementation for this scoped finding; owner acceptance remains separate.

items.title: Known reviewed correction is missing beside the original saved proposal
items.behavior: A read-only note and pinned correction link accompany the exact affected original response, matched by entry, input hash, result reference and body. Original text remains unchanged.
items.remaining: No further implementation for this scoped finding; owner acceptance remains separate.

items.title: Additional provider connectors
items.currentLimit: Only the fixed Groq contract is live-supported. No fallback or provider activation is implied.
items.next: Review separate provider identity, costs, scope and uncertainty semantics before activation.

items.title: Portable host onboarding and installation
items.currentLimit: Manual advanced host enrollment; no general one-command installer or cross-platform qualification.

items.title: Broader routine request enrollment
items.currentLimit: Only independently enrolled finite catalogue inputs/slots may be approved. Arbitrary new prompts are unsupported.
